purpose: Teach: 学内/人名/右上/左上/つけれ/筐/院内/バッティング

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 人事、学内推薦、続けるべきか、検討しましょう。
lines.en: HR and campus recommendations — should we keep going with this? Let's discuss it.
lines.style: Businesslike but not cold. Measured opening. She's framing a topic for team review, confident but collaborative. Slight emphasis on the question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報資料、人名表記、徹底チェックします。
lines.en: Got it. I'll do a thorough check on the PR materials — especially the name formatting.
lines.style: Engaged and straightforward. Quick agreement, then immediate ownership. Competent tone. No hesitation, no filler. Ready to move forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プレゼン、図、右上にKPIを、置きましょう。
lines.en: On the presentation chart — let's put the KPI in the top right.
lines.style: Clear directive. Spoken as if she's already visualizing it. Matter-of-fact delivery, the tone of someone giving a direction she's thought through. Slight pause for acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。スライド左上に、ロゴ、固定します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll lock the logo in the top left of the slide.
lines.style: Confirming and committing. Brief, efficient. The rhythm of someone taking a note and already moving to the next task. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: スマホ、防水ケースをつければ、安心ね、外回り。
lines.en: For field work — if we put phones in waterproof cases, that should keep them safe.
lines.style: Practical reassurance delivered gently. Thinking out loud but settling on a solution. Maternal undertone — she's solved a small worry for the team.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新筐体、デザイン、来週、共有します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll share the new casing design with everyone next week.
lines.style: Agreeing and providing a timeline. Steady, reliable. No overstatement. The confidence of someone who knows what they're committing to.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 病院との連携、院内会議、来週ね。
lines.en: The hospital partnership — we have an in-house meeting next week.
lines.style: Confirming plans. Gentle but definite. She's anchoring the timeline for the room. Light vocal tap on 「来週」. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内バッティングセンター、来期、検討予定です。
lines.en: Got it. We're scheduled to look into the in-house batting center for next term.
lines.style: Wrapping up with a note that lands slightly differently. Tone shifts subtly — this item is less urgent, almost amusing in its contrast to the rest. Still professional, but with a whisper of warmth.
